description: This Java source file defines the JsonExamplesProducer class which generates JSON files representing various connectivity events related to an Eclipse Ditto project. It constructs connection objects with specific configurations, then serializes and writes different event instances (like ConnectionCreated, ConnectionModified, etc.) to JSON files in a specified directory.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates JSON files representing various connectivity events for testing or demo purposes using concatenated fixed configurations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls the generate method with command line arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates the arguments and initiates JSON generation from the specified directory.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Begins production of connectivity event JSON files within a specific subdirectory.

methods.name: produceConnectivityEvents
methods.description: Creates the 'connectivity' directory and triggers event JSON file creation.

methods.name: produceEvents
methods.description: Generates individual JSON representations of various connection events (created, modified, opened, closed, deleted) within the target directory.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to JSON string and writes it to the specified file path.
